links.outcome: LLM note-level accuracy versus gold-standard chart review across six communication domains
links.effect: Sensitivity 0.43 to 1.0, specificity 0.32 to 0.99, accuracy 0.51 to 0.99 versus chart review; average hallucination index low.
links.quote: Across communication domains, compared to chart review, the note-level LLM analysis achieved sensitivity ranging from 0.43 to 1.0, specificity ranging from 0.32 to 0.99, and accuracy ranging from 0.51 to 0.99.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to abstract communication domains from oncology notes for clinician feedback and quality improvement

screen.reason: The study tests the feasibility and accuracy of using GPT-4o with prompt engineering on retrospective oncology clinical notes to extract communication domains and measures hallucination rates, but does not test an organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
